text:
Ana: quick heads-up — spotted two tiny UX/text issues in `docs/runtime/guide/quickstart.md`. The image link at the top points to the old s3 bucket and one param in the example (`--fast-mode`) is outdated; should be `--throughput-mode`. Low impact, ~1-line fixes + rehost screenshot. Who can grab?

Ben: I can take this today, thanks. which exact lines/file path?

Ana: thanks Ben. file: `docs/runtime/guide/quickstart.md`, around line ~120-130 for the param snippet and top-of-doc image link. Also docs-bot flagged a dead anchor earlier — worth checking frontmatter redirects.

Ben: ok will search for the anchor too. quick sed to inspect the section: `sed -n '115,135p' docs/runtime/guide/quickstart.md`

Claire: FYI docs-bot ran link-check this morning and found a 404 for `https://s3.redwood/old/quickstart.png` and also a missing `#deploy-config` anchor. probably add redirect frontmatter + rehost asset to CDN. tagging runtime owners.

docs-bot: Link-check report (auto): `docs/runtime/guide/quickstart.md` -> https://s3.redwood/old/quickstart.png (404) — occurrences: 1. Suggest rehost asset to `assets/quickstart.png` and update link. Report: https://internal.tools/linkscan/1781234567

Ben: cool, i'll: 1) update link to `/assets/quickstart.png`, 2) rehost image under `static/assets/quickstart.png`, 3) replace `--fast-mode` -> `--throughput-mode`, 4) add frontmatter redirect for `#deploy-config` if anchor truly moved. will open PR and include a small test to assert link resolves.

Ana: perfect. small ask — can the PR also update `tests/docs_links.test.js` to assert the new path returns 200? it's a two-line change.

Claire: I can add that test snippet (super small). drop the test in the PR and i'll push it.

Ben: PR opened: https://git.company/ri/docs/pull/4521 — includes the sed patch for param rename, updated image link, added `static/assets/quickstart.png`, frontmatter redirect, and tests. please review when you get a sec.

Jordan (editor): reviewing now. one wording nit: change "fast" -> "low-latency" in the first paragraph for clarity. pushed suggestion on the PR.

Ben: applied the suggestion, re-ran CI, all green. ready for merge pending one more eng review.

Ana: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. moving this to done and adding a follow-up note on the docs sprint board.

Claire: noted — i'll also update the docs sweep checklist to flag `#deploy-config` there so we don't lose it next scan.

Ben: merged. thanks all.
